info.name: Passwort OTP Code Generator
info.summary: View and copy TOTP codes, including shared entries, and create OTP entries
info.description: Unofficial companion for Nextcloud Passwords: view and copy your own or shared TOTP codes, and create new Passwords entries with OTP fields. Supports client-side TOTP generation and Passwords CSE authentication. Does not edit or delete existing entries. Tested with Nextcloud 35.0.2 and Passwords 2026.11.20. See SECURITY.md for security boundaries.
info.author: RamonP12
